notes: thresholds are derived from the runs listed in baseline.runs; they are not copied from another project and they are not a device footprint

rules.description: the process floor: what a Box-capable binary already holds at its earliest observable point
rules.basis: derived from 6 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 2104384..2131400; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+16384) with 16384 of noise allowance

rules.description: the absolute ledger for an idle base Box with no activity history
rules.basis: derived from 6 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 2425048..2452128; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+16384) with 16384 of noise allowance

rules.description: Go's own total for an idle base Box, including memory the heap reading does not classify
rules.basis: derived from 6 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 15558904..20023544; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+65536) with 65536 of noise allowance

rules.description: the goroutine floor of an idle base Box
rules.basis: derived from 6 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 27..28; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+1) with 1 of noise allowance

rules.description: what box.New adds over the decoded configuration for the base Box
rules.basis: derived from 6 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 17256..24144; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+8192) with 8192 of noise allowance

rules.description: goroutines still running after Close returned
rules.basis: derived from 6 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 24..24; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+1) with 1 of noise allowance

rules.description: live heap above the earliest observable point after Close: the release has to actually happen
rules.basis: derived from 6 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 215496..252128; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+16384) with 16384 of noise allowance

rules.description: the ordinary code path with no nodes: it must not cost more than the base Box
rules.basis: derived from 3 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 2442520..2449472; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+16384) with 16384 of noise allowance

rules.description: per-node live-heap cost of 100 configured, never-dialled trojan nodes, measured right after construction
rules.basis: derived from 3 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 7561..7678; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+128) with 128 of noise allowance

rules.description: per-node live-heap cost of the same nodes once the Box is started and idle
rules.basis: derived from 3 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 9936..9956; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+128) with 128 of noise allowance

rules.description: never-dialled nodes must not buy a goroutine each
rules.basis: derived from 3 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 27..27; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+1) with 1 of noise allowance

rules.description: never-dialled nodes must not buy an operating-system thread each
rules.basis: derived from 3 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 20..21; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+1) with 1 of noise allowance

rules.description: a URL test round over eight local members must reach all of them
rules.basis: derived from 3 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 8..8; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+1) with 1 of noise allowance

rules.description: an untouched Box must not grow across one second of natural idle (no forced collection)
rules.basis: derived from 3 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 0..15936; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+8192) with 8192 of noise allowance

rules.description: live heap per held flow: one buffer plus bookkeeping, not two buffers
rules.basis: derived from 3 baseline run(s) of THIS tree: observed 44942..46350; threshold = ceil(max(observed)*1.25, observed+2048) with 2048 of noise allowance

rules.description: the traffic fixture must verify both directions
rules.basis: business check, not a budget: 3 of 3 baseline run(s) satisfied it; the minimum is the definition of the fixture, not a measurement threshold

rules.description: the client's half-close must be propagated: the destination only answers after EOF
rules.basis: business check, not a budget: 3 of 3 baseline run(s) satisfied it; the minimum is the definition of the fixture, not a measurement threshold
